format: NDCA nine- and ten-dance competitions (future NDCA body profile)

source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: In a Ten-Dance competition each dance is a separate competition and the Skating System is applied to all ten dances together; in Pro/Am nine- or ten-dance championships the Pro/Am Student Competitor must have the same professional for both events.

requirement: Nine- and ten-dance events are NOT CURRENTLY SUPPORTED by DanceFlow. A future NDCA profile must implement combined scoring and the same-professional rule.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA profile. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23: 'each dance shall be a separate competition' (III.D.36) and 'must be partnered by the same professional' (III.D.38). Page numbers as printed: III.D.36 is on printed p23 (the request cited p22). This does not mean NDCA prohibits or lacks such events.
